proposed_widenings.name: triggered_reaction family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Cutting Words fires as a reaction in response to an external event (enemy's roll). The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which models player-initiated feature use. A 'triggered_reaction' family parallel to TriggeredReactionMechanics for spells is required — including a reaction trigger (what roll type on what target opens the window), activation cost (reaction), cross-feature resource consumption, and a roll-modifier effect on the target.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration

proposed_widenings.name: reaction in ClassFeatureActivationCost
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation cost of Cutting Words is the character's Reaction. ClassFeatureActivationCost only models 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A 'reaction' variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect subtracts the Bardic Inspiration die result from the triggering creature's roll. The v4 atom 'modify_roll_numeric' exists but is not available in ClassFeatureEffect (only grant_extra_action and heal_hp are). Additionally, this effect targets an enemy's roll rather than a friendly roll, requiring a negative-delta / enemy-target variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll

proposed_widenings.name: damage_roll and ability_check in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: Cutting Words can be triggered by a damage roll or an ability check, neither of which is in the current RollKind type ('attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'). The trigger grammar requires these two new RollKind members.
proposed_widenings.evidence: makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll

proposed_widenings.name: cross-feature resource reference
proposed_widenings.justification: Cutting Words expends one use of Bardic Inspiration — a pool owned by the bard_bardic_inspiration_l1 feature, not a dedicated Cutting Words pool. The current class feature resource model gives each feature its own independent use_count. A cross-feature resource reference (consume from a named sibling feature's pool) is not representable.
proposed_widenings.evidence: expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration

notes: No Dhall/JSON/trace produced. Cutting Words is a reaction-triggered class feature with no structural analog in the current type system. The blocking gap is the missing 'triggered_reaction' family for ClassFeatureMechanics. Secondary gaps: 'reaction' cost variant, modify_roll_numeric class feature effect, damage_roll/ability_check RollKind members, and cross-feature resource consumption. The Bardic Inspiration die's die-size scaling (d6→d12 by bard level) would use the existing v4 scale_die_size atom once the structural frame exists.
